about: Iron Man suits from the Marvel films, a line or two each. Hand-written for this site from watching the films: fan knowledge, not an official source. build.mjs marks every one with fan: true, and Jarvis says so when he reads one.

suits.name: Mark 1
suits.line: Built from scrap in a cave in Afghanistan so Tony Stark could escape his captors. Grey, riveted and armed with flamethrowers, it was the first suit of all.

suits.name: Mark 2
suits.line: The silver prototype, built in the Malibu workshop. Its first climb to high altitude ended with the suit icing up.

suits.name: Mark 3
suits.line: The first red and gold suit. A gold-titanium alloy solved the icing problem, and it fought Iron Monger.

suits.name: Mark 5
suits.line: The suitcase suit. It unfolds from a briefcase, and Tony wore it against Whiplash on the race track in Monaco.

suits.name: Mark 6
suits.line: Powered by the triangular arc reactor and the new element Tony made for it. It fought the drones at the Stark Expo.

suits.name: Mark 7
suits.line: Fired from Stark Tower in a pod, it wraps itself round Tony as he falls. He wore it in the Battle of New York.

suits.name: Mark 42
suits.line: Its pieces fly to Tony on their own, steered by implants in his arms, so it can put itself on him from across a room.

suits.name: Mark 43
suits.line: The suit from the opening raid on the Hydra base in Sokovia, and the fight with Ultron that followed.

suits.name: Hulkbuster
suits.line: A giant armour that fits over another suit, sent down in pieces by a support system called Veronica. It was built to stop the Hulk, and fought him in Johannesburg.

suits.name: Mark 46
suits.line: The suit Tony wore in the fight at the airport in Germany, against Captain America and his side.

suits.name: Mark 47
suits.line: A red and silver suit that Tony often flew by remote control, keeping an eye on Peter Parker.

suits.name: Mark 50
suits.line: Nanotech. It lives in a housing on Tony's chest and flows over him, forming shields, blades and thrusters as he needs them. He fought Thanos in it on Titan.

suits.name: Mark 85
suits.line: Tony's last suit. In it he took the Infinity Stones from Thanos and snapped his fingers.
